summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements and proposals, including the potential deprecation of equality deletes in Iceberg V4 and the addition of Vortex as a new file format. Additionally, there is an ongoing conversation about enabling GitHub Copilot for code reviews and leveraging sort order metadata for performance improvements in Spark.
highlights: Discussion on deprecating equality deletes in Iceberg V4
Proposal to add Vortex as an Iceberg file format
Discussion on enabling GitHub Copilot for code reviews
Leveraging Iceberg sort order metadata for performance optimizations in Spark
